paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Model complexity analysis.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between vocabulary size and scaled complexity ratios for three different models. The x-axis is labeled "Vocabulary Size" and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40000 with tick intervals of 5000. The y-axis is labeled "Scaled Ratio" and also utilizes a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1.0 with tick intervals of 0.1. The blue line represents "Input Complexity," beginning at approximately 0.95 and decreasing to approximately 0.40 at a vocabulary size of 25000, subsequently remaining relatively constant. The cyan line represents "Embedding Complexity," starting around 0.85 and decreasing to approximately 0.35 at a vocabulary size of 25000, and then increasing to approximately 0.60 at a vocabulary size of 40000. The green line represents "Embedded Complexity," beginning at around 0.75 and decreasing to approximately 0.25 at a vocabulary size of 25000, remaining steady at this value until reaching a final value of approximately 0.30 at a vocabulary size of 40000.
